name: Spicy Cajun Macaroni with Ground Chicken, Veggies & Cheese

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 green bell peppers
3 sticks celery
1 small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley

instructions.primary_message: Trim, seed, and small dice bell peppers. Place in a medium bowl.
Trim and small dice celery. Add to the bowl with the bell pepper.
Peel, halve, and small dice onions. Add to the bowl with the other veggies along with the carrots.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ medium yellow onions
1 ½ (283 g) bags shredded carrots

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies, chicken, Cajun seasoning, and salt. Cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 5-6 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
0.68 kg ground chicken
¼ cup Cajun seasoning
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Add water, tomato sauce, and pasta to the pot. Stir to combine, cover, and bring to a boil. Once boiling, reduce heat to medium-low and simmer (while covered) until pasta is tender and the liquid is mostly absorbed, 8-10 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cup water
3 (213 ml) cans tomato sauce
425 g macaroni (elbow) pasta

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Set aside.
When the pasta is done, add parsley, stir to combine, and remove from heat.
To serve, divide pasta between plates or bowls and sprinkle with cheese. Enjoy!
